task.title: Creating quota notifications by using the API
task.shortdesc: To create quota warning or error notifications for organization and user namespaces in Red Hat Quay, you can use the API. Warning limits trigger quota_warning events and reject limits trigger quota_error events.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.
FEATURE_QUOTA_MANAGEMENT is enabled in your Red Hat Quay configuration.
FEATURE_QUOTA_NOTIFICATIONS is enabled in your Red Hat Quay configuration.

Optional: You have established quota limits for your organization or user namespace. You can create notification rules before setting quota limits. Notifications trigger automatically after quotas are configured and thresholds are crossed.
You have administrative privileges for the namespace.

context.p: Warning-type quota limits trigger quota_warning notifications. Reject-type quota limits trigger quota_error notifications. For organization email notifications, "config": {} is valid because recipients are resolved server-side (organization contact email, or organization administrators if unset). User email notifications are sent to the user account email address.

Red Hat Quay throttles repeated alerts for the same namespace and threshold by using QUOTA_NOTIFICATION_COOLDOWN_SECONDS (default: 86400 / 24 hours). If usage drops below a threshold and later crosses it again, the notification can re-fire. Deleting a quota also removes associated quota_warning and quota_error notification rules for that namespace.
